scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Positive-coupling triangular three-spin plaquette Ising model on dyadic toroidal squares of side \(L=2^k\ge8\); count simultaneous flips of one through three spins.
limitations: Proof does not give a sharp three-spin entropy or dynamical quench probabilities.
The relative entropy-gap constant is nonoptimal and derived via a conservative 5x5 block witness.
The complete text of the original Baxter 1980 paper was not accessible; its hard-hexagon pressure is standard prior work.
Prior-art coverage is not guaranteed exhaustive; external independent review has not been performed.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Spin-defect invertibility via binary Frobenius, elementary hard-core geometry, uniform conditional block counting; finite exhaustive verification supplements the proof.

title: Cooperative escape separates the one-, two-, and three-spin metastable entropies of the triangular plaquette model
